# biznetgio_gpu_products (Data Source)

GPU product catalog, including available flavors per product.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "biznetgio" {}

data "biznetgio_gpu_products" "all" {}

output "gpu_products" {
  value = data.biznetgio_gpu_products.all.products
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier of the data source.
- `products` (Attributes List) List of GPU products. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products))

<a id="nestedatt--products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products`

Read-Only:

- `category_name` (String) Product category.
- `description` (String) Product description.
- `flavors` (Attributes List) Available flavors of the product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products--flavors))
- `name` (String) Product name.
- `product_id` (Number) Product id, orderable in `biznetgio_gpu_instance`.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Raw JSON of the product, for anything not modeled yet.

<a id="nestedatt--products--flavors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products.flavors`

Read-Only:

- `flavor_id` (Number) Flavor id.
- `name` (String) Flavor name.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Raw JSON of the flavor.
